veranderings.voor: Skeur 'n derde stuk van die rand af en kyk
veranderings.na: Probeer om 'n derde stuk van die rand af te skeur en kyk
veranderings.rede: An order to tear the piece and then check whether it stays whole contradicts itself; 'probeer' matches the earlier 'probeer dit buig' and leaves the protected 'van die rand af' intact.

veranderings.voor: wanneer jy optel, buig of trek
veranderings.na: wanneer jy hulle optel, buig of trek
veranderings.rede: The transitive verbs need an object; the lesson's later sentence uses 'wanneer jy hulle optel' the same way.

veranderings.voor: trek water by homself in en hou dit vas
veranderings.na: trek water in en hou dit vas
veranderings.rede: 'by homself' is wooden and adds nothing, since 'intrek' already means drawing into itself; belongs with the matching glossary change for 'absorberend', so apply both or neither.

veranderings.voor: water by homself intrek en dan nat word
veranderings.na: water intrek en dan nat word
veranderings.rede: Same wooden 'by homself' as in the study text; apply together with that change so the two wordings stay alike.

veranderings.voor: Nou het jy die glas beskryf en nie net een woord daaroor gesê nie.
veranderings.na: Nou het jy die glas met meer as een woord beskryf.
veranderings.rede: The 'and not just said one word about it' tail is clumsy; the shorter sentence says the same thing directly.

vlae.blok: Hard of sag; Styf of buigbaar; Sterk of swak; Waterdig of absorberend
vlae.teks: Druk op 'n droë stuk hout en jy maak geen duik daarin nie.
vlae.rede: Several sentences join an imperative to a clause with its own subject by 'en' without a comma; the imperative has no stated subject, so I left them as they are, but the reviewer may want to confirm the house reading of the AWS rule for this pattern.
